summary: All-spectrum presentation, explicit seed selection, selected presentation and scientific output terminal.

identity.direction: Declared scientific input ports in one mapping -> completed scientific state and declared artifacts
identity.definition: All-spectrum presentation, explicit seed selection, selected presentation and scientific output terminal. inputs mapping: scan_state,seeds required; scales=(1,1,1),runtime=0,rng_seed=None. All physical operator contracts and artifact limits apply. Scientific graph nodes reuse the declared native numerical relations; a fused native implementation may execute them in one process. Controlled glue only schedules, carries state and projects results. The public Python wrapper accepts one inputs mapping; each listed scientific port is an entry of that mapping, with required/default status from the actual underlying callable.
identity.model: Uniform magnetized, nonrelativistic charged Gaussian species with optional gyrotropic loss-cone mixture; B0 along signed z and k=(kx,0,kz).
identity.geometry: Cartesian k=(kx,0,kz), B0 along signed z; non-spatial representation for pole/partition operators.
identity.coordinates: SI angular frequency rad/s and wave number m^-1; normalized source scan/selection quantities are labeled explicitly.
identity.boundary: Uniform/local plane-wave response; no spatial boundary-value problem or nonlinear saturation.
assumptions: All nodes consume compatible scientific predecessor state.
Ordinary dependencies are acyclic; feedback, when present, has the stated finite schedule.
Mode selection is an explicitly defined algorithm; physical uniqueness is not asserted.

inputs.name: scan_state
inputs.description: Genuine completed magnetized spectral-scan NativeResult or its immutable state mapping. Includes dimensional ww and final d, physical equilibrium, source grid/control fields and normalization by the positive reference wcs1=abs(wcs(1)) from canonical initialization.
inputs.units: mixed; physical dimensions recorded by state fields
inputs.constraints: Produced by workflows.scan_spectrum or solve_dispersion with compatible iem/iout and the intended scan grid; no synthetic replacement of missing fields.

inputs.name: seeds
inputs.description: Rows(pa,pb,complex normalized target). Nonzero real target selects by real part; exactly zero real target selects by imaginary part.
inputs.constraints: npl>=1; coordinates belong to the existing scan. First-index ties and source nearest/PCHIP ordering retained; seeds do not certify mode identity.

inputs.name: scales
inputs.constraints: Exactly three compatible native scalar factors; source plotting conventions retained. No hidden normalization globals.

inputs.name: runtime
inputs.description: Elapsed-time annotation supplied by caller; does not affect scientific roots.
inputs.constraints: Display metadata; caller supplies finite elapsed time.

inputs.name: rng_seed
inputs.description: Optional startup rand/randn seed for controlled comparisons.
inputs.constraints: None retains native startup RNG. Applied once at action entry; no reset within a scientific kernel loop. Public examples use2718.

outputs.name: state
outputs.description: Completed NativeResult.state with compatible native scientific carrier and typed artifacts.
outputs.constraints: Compatible typed scientific predecessor; native stored dimensions are retained; trailing singleton axes may be omitted while interior singleton axes remain and inactive fields remain empty arrays.

outputs.name: Pola
outputs.description: Zero-based channels0:6 are Ex,Ey,Ez,Bx,By,Bz, channel6 is UE and channel7 is UB; channels8:20 are reserved zero-filled slots, not computed diagnostics.
outputs.units: E relative to unit electric amplitude; B T for E=1V/m; energy J m^-3 under that convention
outputs.shape: (npa,npb,npl,20) when iout2 allocates; otherwise empty or supplied predecessor shape
outputs.constraints: iout2 allocates Pola and initializes wws2 from selected wws regardless of iem. Only completed EM iout2 computes physical fields and newly solved selected frequencies. ES iout2 zero/forwarded carriers and any partial terminal state are not qualified physical fields; no successful ES iout2 terminal is asserted. iout1 does not reconstruct and may leave empty arrays or retain supplied predecessor carriers. A failed terminal exposes partial state through SourceOutputError.result.

outputs.name: wws2
outputs.description: Selected-frequency carrier initialized from wws; completed EM iout2 overwrites points with actually recomputed frequencies. A partial failure can retain a mixture of completed and forwarded values.
outputs.shape: For iout2: (npa,npb,npl) when npl>1 or (npa,npb) when npl=1; otherwise empty or supplied predecessor shape
outputs.constraints: iout2 allocates Pola and initializes wws2 from selected wws regardless of iem. Only completed EM iout2 computes physical fields and newly solved selected frequencies. ES iout2 zero/forwarded carriers and any partial terminal state are not qualified physical fields; no successful ES iout2 terminal is asserted. iout1 does not reconstruct and may leave empty arrays or retain supplied predecessor carriers. A failed terminal exposes partial state through SourceOutputError.result.

outputs.name: figure_png
outputs.constraints: Accessible in returned NativeResult.state; scientific meaning applies only to a compatible completed predecessor. Empty inactive arrays are preserved.

outputs.name: figure_native
outputs.constraints: Accessible in returned NativeResult.state; scientific meaning applies only to a compatible completed predecessor. Empty inactive arrays are preserved.

outputs.name: workspace_mat
outputs.description: Opaque native saved-workspace bytes; writer may use Octave text format despite .mat suffix.
outputs.constraints: Accessible in returned NativeResult.state; scientific meaning applies only to a compatible completed predecessor. Empty inactive arrays are preserved.

preconditions: inputs mapping: scan_state,seeds required; scales=(1,1,1),runtime=0,rng_seed=None. All physical operator contracts and artifact limits apply.
supported: Explicit DAG composition with bounded native feedback where declared.
excluded: Physical branch uniqueness, arbitrary changes to source state, visual acceptance and unbounded root searches.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: Declared Python guards raise ValueError; incomplete or inconsistent state may raise KeyError or a native indexing/domain error. No silent physical-model substitution.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: NativeExecutionError records unavailable/failed/timed-out Octave execution. source_output additionally raises SourceOutputError with retained result and receipt when its caught scientific terminal fails.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: Eigen/interpolation/selection native failure is observable; no failed root is converted to a successful mode. This operator does not certify global root convergence.
failure_semantics.partial_results: Completed NativeResult carries immutable state and receipt. source_output failures expose partial artifacts through exception.result; other failed native calls do not promise a completed scientific state.

example.description: Small wheel-only example using packaged native resources and raw Octave; no source checkout or network.
example.code:
import numpy as np
from scirel.kinetic.pdrk import magnetized as m, workflows as w
deck=np.array([[1,1,1e6,100,100,1,1,0],[-1,1,1e6,100,100,1,1,0.]])
controls=dict(B0=1e-7,N=1,J=4,sp=0,iem=1,iout=2,ipa=3,ipb=3,iloga=0,ilogb=0,pa1=.2,pa2=.4,dpa=.1)
eq=m.initialize_equilibrium(deck,controls=controls,par=[.2,0,.2,0,0,0])
scan=w.scan_spectrum({'state':eq,'rng_seed':2718})
roots=np.asarray(scan.state['ww']);j=int(np.argmax(roots[0,0].real))
seeds=np.array([[.2,0,roots[0,0,j]/float(scan.state['wcs1'].item())]])
r=w.rendered_output({'scan_state':scan,'seeds':seeds,'rng_seed':2718})
assert r.state['output_completed'].item()
assert r.state['workspace_mat'].size>0
example.expected: NOT_RUN (environment): the example requires GNU Octave on Linux amd64; this macOS checkout has no octave executable, so NativeExecutionError is expected and no scientific result is claimed.

scope: Bounded canonical and fresh-holdout graph-state checks: actual grid, newly computed d/D, normalized fields, energy, phase and nondegenerate Maxwell-row residual.
Graph data and artifacts preserve declared scientific state; final installed signature/example validation is required.
verification.evidence_ceiling: Direct contract tests and the declared finite cases bound the relation only where their numeric gates apply; native PDRK execution requires GNU Octave on Linux amd64 and is NOT_RUN in this macOS checkout.
known_limitations: Local technical development; human scientific endorsement and publication clearance remain pending.
Finite harmonic N and rational-pole J approximations require independent convergence checks for a new physical regime.
Passing bounded response, state and backward-error tests does not establish unique physical-mode tracking, all-root forward accuracy or visual acceptance.
Native example and full PDRK qualification require GNU Octave on Linux amd64; current macOS run is NOT_RUN.

Own one field reconstruction when iout2 and write the resulting artifacts/workspace.
Expose the final NativeResult and declared state/artifact fields; do not modify scientific values.

execution.mode: Sequential scientific composition; fused native point relations preserve the same order.
execution.ordering: Listed DAG order; bounded source index feedback is explicit for scan and polarization.
branches: iem selects electromagnetic or electrostatic matrix.
sp selects dense full spectrum or sparse targeted eigenvalues.
iout2 EM owns field reconstruction; iout1 retains frequency-only output.
execution.state_ownership: Caller owns input mapping; each native invocation owns isolated scratch state. Return immutable NativeResult with completed state; no source checkout or hidden mutable global scientific state.
execution.failure_propagation: Python/native/domain/timeout failures propagate. source_output raises SourceOutputError retaining partial terminal artifacts. original_program returns program_completed/program_error separately from transport status; a false completion flag is never scientific success.

references: Xie and Xiao, PDRK: A General Kinetic Dispersion Relation Solver for Magnetized Plasma, Plasma Science and Technology 18 (2016).
